question: Which laptop should we order for the new hire in the support team, who starts on the first Monday of next month?
context: All four are on the approved list and can be delivered before the start date. Prices include tax and the docking cable; the budget for this role is €1,400.

options.name: Standard 14-inch
options.summary: The model most of the team already uses. Same charger and dock as everyone else, so spare parts are easy, and setup takes about an hour with the usual image.

options.name: Light 13-inch with the longer battery option
options.summary: Noticeably lighter and quieter, good for someone who moves between desks and rooms a lot. The smaller screen is fine with the dock, a little tight without it.

options.name: Performance 16-inch
options.summary: More memory and a large screen, more than this role needs today. Heavier, louder under load, and above the budget for the role by a small amount.

facts.label: Warranty
facts.value: 3 years, on site, next business day

options.name: Refurbished 14-inch
options.summary: Last year's standard model, checked and with a new battery. The cheapest choice by far, with a shorter warranty and a small scratch on the lid.
